title: Getting started
summary: Host your first Burning Empires Coop server.

sections.heading: What you need
steps: Bannerlord 1.4.8 on Windows, and Bannerlord Coop from the Steam Workshop.
Burning Empires 2.0.2 from Nexus Mods. Get the main file and the hotfix, and leave both downloads as they are.
Click Install or repair Burning Empires. The server tool puts Burning Empires in for you.
Installing by hand? Install the main file first, then the hotfix.
Harmony, ButterLib and UIExtenderEx from the Steam Workshop, and MCM from Nexus Mods in the game's Modules folder. The tool tells you when one is missing.
The tool finds the dedicated server inside the Workshop Coop folder by itself.
sections.tip: The client launcher has the same Install or repair Burning Empires button, so either tool can set up the game.

sections.heading: Make a campaign
steps: Type a name and click New campaign. The server starts a fresh Burning Empires world under that name.
You can also host a single player Burning Empires save. Pick it under Pick that save.
If it says Single player copy, click Name server copy. Your Documents save stays as it is.
A save without Burning Empires does not load. Pick a Burning Empires save or start a new campaign.

sections.heading: Start the server
steps: Click Prepare server once. It copies the dedicated server and the files Burning Empires needs on it.
The first time, read the Coop server terms and click I accept.
The first time, Windows may ask to allow .NET Host. Click Allow so players can join.
Wait until the status says Server online. A gold bar shows the progress while it starts.
sections.tip: The first start of a new campaign builds the world and can take a long time. Do not stop the server while it does.

sections.heading: Next time
steps: The same campaign stays ready. Pick the Server copy and click Start server.
Stop server saves the world first, then closes the server.
A server that is still loading stops right away, with no save.
Click What's new under the language button to see what changed in the last few versions.
